transcript.content: Hello, thank you for coming in. Can you tell me what’s been bringing you here today?

Well... I guess things have just been feeling a bit off lately. The things that usually make me feel like myself... like taking my camera out for walks, or mentoring the kids... even just keeping a clean calendar at work. It all just started feeling kind of... flat. Heavy, I guess. 

I just stopped initiating them. So... yeah. That's what made me come in.
How long have you been feeling this way?

A while. Um... maybe a year and three months, I think. 

It kind of started after... well, a family member had some health issues. Their behavior changed, and I had to step in and take on a lot of the coordination for them. So... yeah. Around then.
Have you noticed a decrease in your interest or enjoyment in activities like taking photos or mentoring kids since this feeling started?
Yeah... I guess so. Just, um... like I said, they feel flat. I don't really get much out of them right now.
Do you feel this way most of the day, nearly every day, or does it come and go?
Um... I don't really know. I haven't exactly kept track of it like that. It's just... kind of how things are right now, I guess.
Can you describe if this feeling of things being flat and heavy stays with you most of the day, nearly every day, or are there times when you truly feel like yourself again?

I mean... like I just said, I don't really keep track of it hour by hour. It's just mostly how things are. I don't really know what feeling like myself is even supposed to mean right now. It's just... flat.
Can you think of specific days or periods in the past few weeks when you actually felt like yourself again, or has the feeling of flatness been pretty much constant?
I don't know... I guess it's just been constant. I haven't really had any days where I felt different. It's just all kind of the same.
So you mentioned it's been mostly the same every day. Would you say that the flatness you're feeling is there for most of the day, nearly every day?

Yeah... mostly. I mean, that's why I'm here. The things I usually do... like going on photography walks, or mentoring the kids... even just keeping my calendar organized... they just feel heavy. Flat. I just... I stopped doing them. It's just there all the time.
Have you been feeling down or sad most of the day, nearly every day, for the past year or so?
A year? ...No, I don't think so. I haven't really been tracking it that far back, but... it hasn't been a year. Just lately, I guess.
Have you had days where you felt down or sad most of the time, not just a little discouraged or tired, but really down, and if so, did that happen most days for a period of at least two weeks?
I don't know... I guess not. I haven't really felt sad like that. Just... flat, like I said. Not sad.
Have you lost interest in doing things you used to enjoy, like photography or mentoring, not just because they feel flat, but because they no longer bring you any pleasure or satisfaction at all?
I... I don't think so. It's not that I don't like them anymore. It's just... like I said, it's just heavy. I don't think it's about not getting pleasure from it. It's just hard to do.
